    JacksonJsonDataFormat
    The application/json data format of object variables, based on Jackson 3.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2AccessorNaming
    Property names of getters and setters like Jackson 2, which Jackson 3 no longer offers: leading upper-case letters are lower-cased (getURL() is "url", not "URL"), and accessors whose name continues with a lower-case letter, a digit or "_" (getvalue(), get1st(), get_links()) are properties as well.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2AccessorNaming.LegacyNaming
     
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2AccessorNaming.LegacyRecordNaming
     
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2CompatibilityModule
    The Jackson 2 compatible serializers and deserializers of this mapper.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2EnumContainerDeserializers
    Properties declared as Map with an enum key or as Set of an enum, read as LinkedHashMap and HashSet like Jackson 2; Jackson 3 alone reads them as EnumMap and EnumSet (databind#1853), which changes the key order of a variable that is read and stored again and rejects null in such a set.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2EnumLikeSerializers
    Month as enum ("JANUARY") like Jackson 2, with all enum settings and @JsonFormat; Jackson 3 writes the month number (0).
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2LocaleDeserializer
    Reads a Locale like Jackson 2, also the form Locale.toString() writes for a script or extensions ("zh_TW_#Hant", "th_TH_#u-nu-thai"): Jackson 3 would drop the script and the extensions.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2LocaleKeyDeserializer
    Reads Locale map keys like JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2LocaleDeserializer.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2SqlDateSerializer
    Date like Jackson 2: written as text without a format on the property, it is the value's own toString() ("1970-01-01"); Jackson 3 uses the mapper's date format instead.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2UnwrappedDeserializerModifier
    A class whose @JsonUnwrapped property Jackson really unwraps ignores unknown properties, like Jackson 2.
    JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2YearSerializer
    Year like Jackson 2: a number only if dates are written as timestamps, otherwise text ("2020"); Jackson 3 always writes a number unless the property says otherwise.
